description: Glenwood Green Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located at 1665 U.S. Route 9 in Old Bridge, New Jersey. Managed by Regency Centers, this open-air shopping center has earned an impressive 4.7-star rating from over 161 Google reviews, reflecting its strong reputation among local shoppers. The center serves as a convenient neighborhood hub for residents of Old Bridge and surrounding Middlesex County communities, offering a carefully curated mix of retail stores, services, and dining options. Strategically positioned along the heavily-trafficked Route 9 corridor, Glenwood Green provides easy accessibility and ample parking for shoppers seeking everyday necessities and specialty services. The center's commitment to serving the local community is evident in its tenant mix and well-maintained facilities, making it a reliable choice for both routine shopping trips and special purchases.
